groups.title: Florida — Kennedy Space Center & Cape Canaveral

sites.name: Pad 1 (Pad A / OLP-1)
sites.role: Original orbital launch mount; Mechazilla tower hosted early booster catches (e.g. B12, B14, B15). Being upgraded toward Pad 2 V3 chopstick and catch-pin standards.
sites.last_activity: Flame trench rebuild continues; another angled wall section lifted 20 Nov 2026. Gigabay: final tower crane removed 26 Nov 2026 (NASASpaceflight Starship Update).
sites.notes: Pad 1 V3 rebuild ongoing. Integrated flights since Flight 14 have used Pad 2.

sites.name: Pad 2 (Pad B / OLP-2)
sites.role: Primary Starship/Super Heavy launch site; V3 chopsticks, catch tower, and pad systems.
sites.last_activity: Starship Flight 15 lifted off 2026-11-13T22:47:36Z. Ship 42 caught at the Pad 2 tower 2026-11-14T21:20Z (first Starship upper-stage catch). Booster 22 catch aborted; lost offshore after FTS at landing-burn shutdown.
sites.notes: Flight 15 achieved the first Starship upper-stage tower catch. Unconfirmed: pad being prepared for Booster 23 rollout and static fire in early December 2026 (TrackingTheSB, 22 Nov 2026, via Starship Desk W48).

sites.name: KSC LC-39A — Starship pad
sites.role: East Coast Starship launch complex; chopstick tower for Super Heavy and Ship RTLS catch.
sites.last_activity: Acceptance testing reported late Nov 2026; pad nearly complete — no operational launch date published.
sites.notes: Flight 16 launch site unconfirmed: Starbase Pad 2 or LC-39A per NSF reporting (19–20 Nov 2026) and FCC filing context in secondary sources. FAA planning target NET 10 Dec 2026; no SpaceX-official date.

sources.title: NASASpaceflight on X — Cape debut slide change

sites.name: CCSFS SLC-37A — Starship pad
sites.role: First of two planned Starship pads at SLC-37; tower stacking, flame trench, tank farm foundations. FAA/DAF EIS authorizes launches and RTLS/ocean landings pending license.
sites.last_activity: Launch mount under construction (late Nov 2026); no operational date.
sites.notes: Not expected online for near-term flights; LC-39A leads Florida Starship ops.

sources.title: FAA — Starship at Cape Canaveral SLC-37

sites.name: CCSFS SLC-37B — Starship pad (planned)
sites.role: Second planned Starship pad at SLC-37 complex; groundwork reported while SLC-37A leads.
sites.last_activity: Foundations progressing alongside SLC-37A (late Nov 2026); no operational date.
sites.notes: Second pad at SLC-37 complex; environmental approval covers up to two pads.

sites.name: Louisiana — operational Starship sites
sites.role: No operational Starship launch or landing site in Louisiana.
sites.notes: No confirmed operational Starship launch or landing site in Louisiana as of 28 Nov 2026.
